next_step_summary: PR #196 implements only ocr-content-region-bounds-v1: deskewed-preview line bands, candidate bounds, safe padded bounds and fail-safe accepted/rotation_only/full_frame_fallback decisions without changing image pixels. The next authorized bounded step is ocr-content-region-deskew-crop-v1, which may apply rotation and crop only when upstream angle and bounds decisions are accepted, must preserve full-frame fallback otherwise, and must not add Surya/provider calls, illumination/glare/blur processing, Android realtime capture analysis, real contracts, upload, encryption, PII masks, Gemini calls or permanent storage. Actual Surya/provider execution remains deferred by explicit product-owner instruction until the preprocessing and capture-quality block is operational.
